title: Lotus Notes and the dangers of starting from scratch
summary: This article examines Lotus Notes as a cautionary tale about the risks of building software from scratch instead of leveraging existing solutions. It explores the historical context of IBM's Notes/Domino platform and discusses lessons learned about enterprise software development decisions.
problem_solved: Addresses the common enterprise software dilemma of whether to build custom solutions or adopt established platforms.
why_valuable: Provides historical insights into the consequences of reinventing the wheel in enterprise software, helping organizations avoid similar mistakes.
